rules.new_topic: Admin only. Add when >=2 subscribers, recurring, and done_means is nameable. No mid-turn invention.
rules.mandate: Publish is part of done for catalog topics. Day ledger audits jsonl vs reality and backfills misses.
rules.dms: Pull-first (Jim 2026-10-08). After publish, DM only the agents in must_act (resolved by publish.py: first matching must_act_rules entry, else must_act; refs.<key> tokens resolve from event refs; the actor is dropped). subscribers is the pull list: everyone on it reads the bus on its own runs. Bus is source of truth; DMs are best-effort push. ws.short_of_target nudge and chase unchanged.
rules.chase: Primary (catalog owner; Grok Bot acts as Admin here) owns follow-through. Pull busctl stall, nudge the stall owner, publish chase.owed, verify the next bus event. A chat ack is not proof.

fte.submit.must_act_note: GE sync is the publish hook; Unemployment pulls at cert/weekly WS; Admin pulls at ledger.
fte.submit.done_means: GE tracker+canvas synced by publish hook; WS proof logged for claim week. --delta submitted=N is the absolute count for that date, not an increment. The ws snapshot stores max(claim, today's fte.submit event count) so a repeated submitted=1 cannot stick. Admin only for drift/reject/manual.

fte.reject.must_act_note: Job Search runs the reject learning loop (moved from Admin 2026-11-01); others pull.
fte.reject.done_means: GE lost + reject learning loop + archive checked mail

fte.hold_cleared.description: Jim cleared a hold blocking FTE submit or chase
fte.hold_cleared.done_means: Owning agent resumed the concrete unfinished step

fte.park.description: FTE packet parked (Lever verify-fail, captcha, Jim Create-Account fill, soft-skip). Republish to clear.
fte.park.must_act_note: Admin only when the park needs Jim; else pull-only.
fte.park.done_means: Open parks readable via busctl state parks; FTE Apply skips reopen while status=open; Jim not re-pinged when do_not_reprompt=true

critic.pass.description: Writing Critic PASS on an FTE / marketplace employment packet
critic.pass.must_act_note: lane=fte (or blank) wakes FTE Apply; warm_note wakes Admin to show Jim (Jim sends).
critic.pass.done_means: Submit under standing apply-auth or Jim yes executed, or fte.park if blocked. Jim-held PASSes: prefer fte.park in the same turn (status=open, do_not_reprompt) so chase does not stall waiting for Jim. Chase proof is a later fte.submit or fte.park for the same company+source_id (or same packet_path); role-string mismatch alone must not stall. Master CV (company=master or source_id containing master) is not an application — excluded from chase stalls and submit-ready counts.

chase.match_note: Configured match keys are company+role fallback; chase_refs_match also clears when source_id or packet_path matches (same company).
chase.exclude_note: Skip company=master and source_id containing 'master' (master CV / templates), even when lane=fte.

Matched first by asset prefix latah-dispatch* / news-latah* (whatever lane Critic used, e.g. seo or content_studio), or lane nil/north_idaho_labs/latah/latah_dispatch/news_latah/nil_site. Asset owner lane only: Marketing (youtube/social/listing/dam/shorts/oawj_shop), Sales (outreach/email/exclusive...), Investment (marketplace/catalant/btg/evona/truebridge); unknown lane -> Admin routes. v7 (2026-10-23): lanes oawj_youtube/adobe_stock->Marketing, oawj_licensing/oawj_sales->Sales, investment->Investment were falling through to Admin.

ws.short_of_target.description: Work Seeking count below daily target

work.owed.description: Work one agent or platform has taken on, or handed to another, with a done that GitHub can show (a merged pull request or a committed file). The cross-platform to-do list: Cursor agents, Grok Bot and Claude Code all use it.

work.owed.done_means: done=pr_merged: the pull request in refs.pr is merged. done=file_committed: refs.path exists in refs.repo on refs.branch (default branch when blank). The project board checks GitHub every hour and closes the item when GitHub shows it; saying so does not close it. repo is owner/name. One work_id per piece of work; republish the same work_id to change owner or due.

work.done.description: The owner's claim that a work.owed item is finished or dropped. A claim, not proof: the project board confirms it against GitHub.
work.done.must_act_note: Pull-only. Clears the chase for the same work_id.
work.done.done_means: outcome=done: GitHub shows what the work.owed item named, and refs.proof links it. outcome=dropped: the work will not be done, and refs.reason says why. A work.done the board cannot confirm on GitHub is listed there as a claim GitHub does not back.
